name: two-boundary fixed-volume encrypted cellization
security_target: fixed outer sizes and counts with encrypted inner length and type
constraint: must place both trusted boundaries on the existing testbed

name: fixed-size records inside a standard secure tunnel
security_target: standard tunnel cryptography plus shim-enforced fixed records and schedule
constraint: ordinary tunnel padding alone is insufficient

name: verified existing-hardware-assisted boundary
security_target: fixed-volume records using an actually present offload or control-CPU path
constraint: must be verified on installed hardware and software

name: TCP resegmentation
reason: a TCP-aware observer reconstructs the same byte total

name: filterable chaff or cover flow
reason: the defined observer removes distinguishable cover traffic

name: cleartext padding or fragmentation
reason: true length remains derivable from protocol or transport metadata
